headline_marked: [[Bangladesh women beat Netherlands]] by 6 wickets to start T20 World Cup
headline: Bangladesh women beat Netherlands by 6 wickets to start T20 World Cup
summary: Juwairia Ferdous shines with a half-century as the Tigresses secure a dominant victory in their opening Group 1 match.
details: The Bangladesh women's national cricket team began their T20 World Cup campaign with a convincing 6-wicket victory over the Netherlands.
The match took place at Edgbaston in England, where the Netherlands won the toss and elected to bat first.
The Dutch side managed to score 139 runs for the loss of 8 wickets in their allotted 20 overs.
Bangladesh chased down the target, reaching the score with 5 balls remaining in the match.
Opener Juwairia Ferdous played a pivotal role in the win, scoring a top score of 50 runs off just 33 balls.
Her aggressive knock included 7 fours and 2 sixes, providing the necessary momentum for the Bangladesh team.

headline_marked: BGB [[foils BSF attempt to push 9 people]] into Bangladesh in Kurigram
headline: BGB foils BSF attempt to push 9 people into Bangladesh in Kurigram
summary: Border Guard Bangladesh personnel and local villagers blocked an attempt by India's Border Security Force to force people across the border in Roumari Upazila.
details: Border Guard Bangladesh (BGB) successfully prevented India's Border Security Force (BSF) from pushing nine people into Bangladesh through two border points in Kurigram's Roumari Upazila on Sunday morning.
The incident occurred at the Goyatapara and Bhandhurchar border areas. The group of nine included six men, one woman, and two children, who were stalled on the zero line due to BGB's intervention.

According to Lieutenant Colonel Hasanur Rahman, commander of the Jamalpur 35 BGB Battalion, the BSF attempted to force six people across the Goyatapara Bangshirchar Battala border and three more across the Bhandhurchar border around 6am.
BGB personnel quickly took positions and were supported by local villagers who helped strengthen surveillance. This joint effort ensured the individuals remained on the Indian side of the border.
Lieutenant Colonel Hasanur stated that the BGB remains firm in protecting national sovereignty and border security, noting that surveillance has been further strengthened following the attempt.
Local Upazila council Member Sona Mia reported that the individuals are currently remaining about 50 yards inside Indian territory, while locals remain on high alert alongside the BGB.
caption:
BGB and local villagers block BSF attempt to force 9 people across the border in Kurigram.

Border Guard Bangladesh (BGB) successfully prevented India's Border Security Force (BSF) from pushing nine people into Bangladesh through two border points in Kurigram's Roumari Upazila on Sunday morning.

The incident occurred at the Goyatapara and Bhandhurchar border areas. The group of nine included six men, one woman, and two children, who were stalled on the zero line due to BGB's intervention.

According to Lieutenant Colonel Hasanur Rahman, commander of the Jamalpur 35 BGB Battalion, the BSF attempted to force six people across the Goyatapara Bangshirchar Battala border and three more across the Bhandhurchar border around 6am.

BGB personnel quickly took positions and were supported by local villagers who helped strengthen surveillance. This joint effort ensured the individuals remained on the Indian side of the border.

Lieutenant Colonel Hasanur stated that the BGB remains firm in protecting national sovereignty and border security, noting that surveillance has been further strengthened following the attempt.

Local Upazila council Member Sona Mia reported that the individuals are currently remaining about 50 yards inside Indian territory, while locals remain on high alert alongside the BGB.
